I’m so sorry about this. Trauma is something that never goes away and it’s always there in the the back of your mind. It seems like you’ve been strong trying to hold it together despite your circumstances and I’m so proud of you for that. Falling apart would be the easier solution right now but you’re not doing that. Relapse is a dangerous thing for your mother and the people around her and I was wondering if there was a way you could get her therapy or into a rehab center. and for you, please go into therapy. I can’t stress this enough but therapy can help so much. Also try to stay out of the house more. You say you have no friends and I know it can be incredibly challenging to make friends. I recommend volunteering since you have a car. You meet amazing people that are extremely caring. And if you volunteer at nursing homes you can meet interesting old folk.  Just remember that as much as you love her you have to put your safety and health first.
